evidence.excerpt: Voquill is an open-sourced alternative to Wispr Flow, so you know where your audio bytes are going. We're also building up some awesome features that our Discord users want. We just built a new one called styles, that add a layer of post processing to whatever you say.

posts.excerpt: Voquill is an open-sourced alternative to Wispr Flow, so you know where your audio bytes are going. We're also building up some awesome features that our Discord users want. We just built a new one called styles, that add a layer of post processing to whatever you say.
